contexts.text: Evil Spirits excite man's evil deeds and then accuse and condemn. AC 761. AC 5036:4. Example(s). See Accuse.
Diabolical Spirits... induce what is false and at the same time accuse. AR 554.
To accuse = to oppose the doctrine, to maintain it to be false, and to revile.
An accuser = one who attacks, reviles and rebukes...
To accuse also = to dispute with. Explained.
In general, by accusing day and night, is signified the continual influx of falsity from them.
